_comment: Audio Analysis (§10). 'Measured' already existed; 'Sources' is here because it reaches the UI as a String parameter, which the scanner cannot see — it would otherwise ship English in every locale without ever appearing as a gap.

Measure.comment: Catalog entry + screen title. A SOURCE, not a tool — the verb, not a noun for a device

Sources.comment: Catalog section above the tools — things that PRODUCE values rather than compute them

Analyse audio, hand values over.es: Analiza el audio y pasa los valores
Analyse audio, hand values over.ja: 音声を解析して値を渡す
Analyse audio, hand values over.pt-BR: Analise o áudio e passe os valores

Measure audio.comment: Card header on the idle Measure screen

Listen to what is playing and hand the n.comment: Explains that measurement is a starting point, never a lock
Listen to what is playing and hand the n.de: Höre mit, was läuft, und übergib die Zahlen an die Rechner. Alles Gefundene bleibt änderbar.
Listen to what is playing and hand the n.fr: Écoutez ce qui joue et transmettez les nombres aux calculateurs. Tout ce qui est trouvé reste modifiable.
Listen to what is playing and hand the n.es: Escucha lo que suena y pasa los números a las calculadoras. Todo lo que encuentre sigue siendo editable.
Listen to what is playing and hand the n.it: Ascolta ciò che suona e passa i numeri ai calcolatori. Tutto ciò che trova resta modificabile.
Listen to what is playing and hand the n.pl: Posłuchaj tego, co gra, i przekaż liczby do kalkulatorów. Wszystko, co znajdzie, pozostaje edytowalne.
Listen to what is playing and hand the n.uk: Прослухай те, що звучить, і передай числа калькуляторам. Усе знайдене лишається редагованим.
Listen to what is playing and hand the n.cs: Poslechni si, co hraje, a předej čísla kalkulačkám. Vše nalezené zůstává upravitelné.
Listen to what is playing and hand the n.hu: Hallgasd meg, ami szól, és add át a számokat a kalkulátoroknak. Minden talált érték szerkeszthető marad.
Listen to what is playing and hand the n.ro: Ascultă ce se aude și trimite numerele către calculatoare. Tot ce găsește rămâne editabil.
Listen to what is playing and hand the n.el: Άκου τι παίζει και δώσε τους αριθμούς στους υπολογιστές. Ό,τι βρεθεί παραμένει επεξεργάσιμο.
Listen to what is playing and hand the n.tr: Çalanı dinle ve sayıları hesaplayıcılara aktar. Bulunan her değer düzenlenebilir kalır.
Listen to what is playing and hand the n.nl: Luister naar wat er speelt en geef de getallen door aan de rekenmachines. Alles wat gevonden wordt, blijft bewerkbaar.
Listen to what is playing and hand the n.sv: Lyssna på det som spelas och skicka siffrorna till kalkylatorerna. Allt som hittas går att ändra.
Listen to what is playing and hand the n.ja: 再生中の音を聴き取り、数値を各計算ツールへ渡します。得られた値はすべて編集できます。
Listen to what is playing and hand the n.ko: 재생 중인 소리를 듣고 수치를 계산기로 전달합니다. 찾은 값은 모두 편집할 수 있습니다.
Listen to what is playing and hand the n.pt-BR: Ouça o que está tocando e passe os números para as calculadoras. Tudo o que for encontrado continua editável.

Listen.comment: Button that starts measuring — also the point at which mic permission is requested

Listening.comment: Card header while capture is running

Measure again.comment: Discards the current session and starts over

Send to.comment: Card header above the routing rows

Revert to typed.comment: VoiceOver rotor action restoring the value the user had before the measurement landed

Integrated.comment: Integrated loudness (ITU-R BS.1770). Analysis REPORTS it; benchmark judges it

True peak.comment: Peak level in dBFS; values above 0 are real inter-sample peaks and are not clamped

Key.comment: Musical key, e.g. F# minor — not a keyboard key and not a password
